THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN WRAP RING OF THREE MOLTEN GOLD STRANDS: three smooth, slightly irregular, high-polish gold strands, like poured liquid gold, sweep side by side across the top of the finger and fan apart. The outer strand is the thickest, about 2.5mm, swelling into a rounded droplet at its end; the middle strand is slimmer, about 1.5mm; the third, fine strand bends around ONE OVAL clear faceted stone held in four slim gold claws, so the oval sits at the front of the ring beside the strands, its long axis along the strands. The strands look hand-poured, with soft ripples, never machined. Exactly one stone: one clear oval, never round, never pear; no pave, no halo, no other stones anywhere; the strands are smooth polished gold, never twisted rope, never textured; exactly three strands, never two, never four.

SCALE TEST: On the finger the ring covers about 15mm of the finger, never wider than the finger, and the oval stone is about a third of the finger's width. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.
